rawHits.title: How long does it take to implement Algolia Search?
rawHits.abstract: It depends on a lot of parameters like the organization of your data, what you want to do with Algolia, and the UI of your website/application.You can get it up and running in 5 minutes. The most complex implementations can take a few weeks. With the majority of our customers having a fully functional search experience in 1 to 10 days after they sign-up. Because we handle most of the back-end heavy-lifting, most of the work is usually to redesign and rethink the User Experience of your website or application. Of course, we’re more than happy to help you through all the process, don’t hesitate to send us an email if you happen to have a question.

AI SEARCH
AI search that understands intent and takes action

Deliver relevant results quickly, with search that learns from behavior, adapts in real time, and continuously improves the experience you deliver.

Get a demo
Get started
More than 18,000 customers in 150+ countries trust Algolia
The AI Search advantage

Algolia is designed for the complexity of real user behavior: messy queries, shifting trends, and constantly changing catalogs.
It handles scale and delivers consistent relevance without requiring constant manual tuning—backed by years of unmatched expertise in search relevance and optimization. Help your customers find what they want faster, leading to stronger engagement, higher conversion rates, and reduced support costs.

An API-first search solution for just about any use case, industry, or team

Flexible by design, ready for real-world complexity
Algolia fits into your architecture and adapts to how your teams work so you can move faster without rethinking your stack. More importantly, you can use search as the foundation for agent-driven experiences.

Industry

Across retail, manufacturing, media, financial services and more, Algolia helps teams improve discovery and drive measurable business impact, from higher conversion to stronger customer satisfaction.

See all industries
Use case

From improving site-wide discovery to powering visual or mobile-first search, Algolia helps you build search-native experiences that can extend into conversational and agent-driven interactions.

See all use cases
Teams

Built for both technical and business users alike, Algolia makes it easy to collaborate on search, from optimizing relevance to managing merchandising and editing.

See all departments
From search results to interactive discovery

Deliver fast, accurate results with a hybrid engine that understands intent, so users can find what they need and keep exploring through conversation.

Control when you need it. Automation when you don’t.

Shape results around your specific goals, or let the system optimize for you. Algolia continuously evaluates performance and adjusts to what drives impact, so you can focus on strategy instead of constant tuning.

Drive performance with smarter ranking

AI Ranking uses real interaction data to refine relevance. It identifies what converts, adjusts automatically, and removes the need for manual rule management.

Curation at your fingertips

Set rules to promote or demote specific items, run A/B tests to measure impact, and see exactly why results appear where they do.

Built for performance at any scale

Algolia processes more than 1 billion queries every 5 seconds, with an average response time under 20 milliseconds. Your search experience stays reliable even during peak traffic.

Features

Everything you need to deliver intelligent search experiences AI-powered search.

NeuralSearch

Hybrid vector and keyword-powered search

Boost results dynamically to drive KPIs

Personalization

Tailor results for each user

AI Synonyms

Automatically detects new synonyms to deliver better results

Results that appear instantly

See all integrations

Move beyond static results. Build conversational interfaces, generate dynamic content, and create workflows where search actively supports discovery and decision-making.
